title: Feature flags
skill: State the override and the rollout rule

good: In src/flags/isEnabled.js, isEnabled(flag, userId, env) returns bucket(flag, userId) >= rollout, which is the wrong way round (a 100% flag is off for everyone), and it ignores FLAG_<NAME>=off. Rules: read env[envName(flag)]; "on" returns true, "off" returns false, any other value is ignored; otherwise return bucket(flag, userId) < rollout. A flag not in config.js stays false. Do not change config.js, hash.js, env.js or the bucket() formula. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: Feature flag rollouts are wrong. Fix it.
